name: sensitive-scan
title: Add sensitive data pre-send scanning with gitleaks rules
description: Scan diff added lines before sending to the LLM for secrets/credentials. Reuse gitleaks v8.30.1 rule data (MIT, 222 rules, 95KB TOML) via a lightweight in-repo matcher; no gitleaks library/CLI dependency. Modes: warn (default), redact, block. Config: sensitive.mode + sensitive.allow; CLI --secrets override on commit/generate/review. Integrates into CommitService.getStagedDiff (covers commit/generate/hook) and ReviewService.getDiff (staged + stdin pipe). Structured SensitiveContentError; docs + FUTURE_FEATURES item 8 marked complete. Non-goals: base64/hex decoding, archive/history scanning, baseline files, changing file_ignore defaults.
creator: belingud
